Keep substantive research decisions with people and make delegated procedural work inspectable.

## Learning goal

Turn your research philosophy into an authority map, monitoring records, and an escalation route.

## Slides

- [Principles and human control](../slides/human-control.qmd)

These decks are working teaching drafts. Slide text is available in the editable Quarto source.

## Main topics

- Human cognitive sovereignty and the principal–agent relationship
- Substantive decisions and procedural implementation
- Monitoring, alignment, and escalation through the responsible human

## Practice

Apply a personal governance layer to your workspace. Submit the authority map, instructions, verification evidence, and a worked escalation case. A clearly labeled simulation can illustrate a PI/RA decision.

Exercise details are proposals for instructor review. The final rubric and submission arrangements will accompany the teaching release.
